purpose: Observe local design-source signals, bounded local PNG screenshot pixels, bounded local browser runtime evidence, and exact before/after screenshot change; normalize reusable evidence into an inspectable Design Genome; compose design plans from explicit component semantics and tokens; apply deterministic structural gates; optionally invoke a caller-selected local Chromium-compatible headless browser to capture real screenshot/DOM bytes and attempt runtime measurements on a temporary instrumented copy; accept attributed render observations without promoting aesthetic preference to objective truth; compare repair renders without claiming that change equals improvement; and derive bounded repair direction from failed or held evidence.

properties.operation: one of inspect-schema, observe-project, derive-genome, validate-genome, compose-plan, judge-plan, materialize, inspect-observer, record-render-observation, judge-rendered, propose-repair, capture-browser, inspect-visual-observer, observe-screenshot, derive-screenshot-genome, observe-render-screenshot, inspect-render-comparison, or compare-render-screenshots
properties.path: materialize target path, capture-browser evidence output directory, or local PNG screenshot path; relative paths resolve from the machine root
properties.target: capture-browser local HTML file or directory containing index.html; URLs are rejected
properties.browser_executable: capture-browser caller-selected Chromium-compatible executable path or explicit PATH name
properties.viewport_sizes: capture-browser exact map from every design-plan viewport id to width/height and optional device_pixel_ratio
properties.viewport: observe-render-screenshot viewport descriptor or compare-render-screenshots exact viewport id present in both render observations
properties.timeout_seconds: capture-browser explicit bounded process timeout from 1 through 120 seconds
properties.observation: derive-genome input using axm.design-observation/v0.1, derive-screenshot-genome input using axm.design-screenshot-observation/v0.1, or judge-rendered input using axm.design-render-observation/v0.1
properties.version: derive-genome or derive-screenshot-genome version, defaults to 0.1.0
properties.purpose: derive-genome or derive-screenshot-genome human-readable design purpose
properties.genome: validate, compose, or materialize axm.design-genome/v0.1 body
properties.request: compose/materialize design request with goal, exact role/component requirements, viewports, and explicit contrast pairs
properties.plan: judge-plan, judge-rendered, or capture-browser axm.design-plan/v0.1 body
properties.plan_digest: record-render-observation or observe-render-screenshot exact design-plan digest
properties.observer: record-render-observation attributed observer descriptor: human, browser-tool, model, test-fixture, or other
properties.captures: record-render-observation bounded viewport captures with declared artifacts, measurements, and attributed assessments
properties.required_assessments: judge-rendered optional exact assessment ids; defaults to visual-hierarchy, spacing-consistency, and component-coherence
properties.before_path: compare-render-screenshots local PNG bytes for the before state
properties.after_path: compare-render-screenshots local PNG bytes for the after state
properties.before_observation: compare-render-screenshots render-observation receipt that declares the exact before screenshot digest
properties.after_observation: compare-render-screenshots render-observation receipt that declares the exact after screenshot digest
properties.replace: materialize only; optional explicit boolean replacement of an existing creation target

anatomy_refs.basis: Design Fabric can observe bounded local project source and local PNG screenshots and can materialize validated descriptors or browser/runtime evidence outside the live machine body.

The genome retains material and surface signals as structured design ingredients while keeping renderer, browser-computed, screenshot-pixel, and repair-delta truth separate from semantic or aesthetic claims.
Component interaction states and motion policy remain explicit design state; browser runtime evidence can observe bounded timing response without silently redefining the animation grammar.

Source, screenshot-pixel, browser-runtime, before/after comparison, and external render evidence remains attributed and digest-bound; deterministic measurements do not become semantic or aesthetic truth.

limitations: local source observation remains lexical/structural source inspection and is distinct from rendered perception
browser capture requires a caller-selected Chromium-compatible executable and never installs or downloads a browser automatically
browser capture accepts local HTML targets only and blocks external host resolution; remote URL capture is unsupported
the runtime probe runs only in a temporary instrumented copy; if the browser or page prevents the marker from being observed, runtime fields remain HOLD rather than being invented
focus evidence is programmatic focus plus computed outline/shadow evidence, not complete keyboard-navigation or tab-order proof
rendered contrast is measured only for observed opaque computed text on an opaque ancestor background; transparency, gradients, images, blending, and more complex compositing remain unproven
accessibility issue counts are bounded DOM heuristics for missing alt text, missing observed control names, duplicate ids, and simple structure counts; they are not a browser accessibility-tree audit

reduced-motion PASS is emitted only for zero observed motion or directly observed duration reduction under a reduced-motion browser run; equal duration remains unproven because motion may be reduced by another mechanism

the browser runtime probe does not click controls, submit forms, perform destructive actions, or claim broad interaction coverage; interaction-error gates remain separate unless explicit interaction evidence is supplied
the minimal visual observer accepts bounded local 8-bit non-interlaced PNG files only and intentionally has no third-party image-model dependency

PNG pixel statistics and quantized color buckets are measurements, not proof of component semantics, text identity, spacing quality, visual hierarchy, component coherence, beauty, originality, accessibility, or intent

before/after comparison measures only exact raster change between same-dimension PNGs whose bytes match bound observation receipts; it does not infer whether the change is intentional, semantically correct, visually better, or a regression
dimension mismatch produces HOLD rather than resampling two different rasters and inventing comparability
CSS selectors are component signals only and do not prove component semantics; roles must come from explicit evidence
external perceptual assessments stay attributed observations and are not promoted to objective aesthetic truth

default rendered-quality judgment still requires explicit visual-hierarchy, spacing-consistency, and component-coherence assessments; browser facts and pixel facts alone cannot create a perceptual visual-quality PASS
a passing integrated judgment proves only that declared gates passed for the exact plan, observer, artifacts, measurements, assessments, and viewports supplied
visual universality, subjective beauty, originality, complete accessibility, runtime correctness, and behavior outside observed conditions remain unproven
repair plans are deterministic directions only; they do not silently rewrite source or accept their own repairs
derived genomes intentionally retain reference grammar signals without reproducing source page composition by default
persistent_state: none required; optional design descriptor projects, browser capture directories, runtime-probe JSON files, screenshot observations, render comparison receipts, and external observation receipts are caller-selected creation state

truth.basis: Source signals, browser-computed runtime facts, runtime-probe gaps, decoded screenshot pixel facts, exact before/after raster deltas, browser-captured bytes, merely declared external artifacts, evidence-integrity checks, observer assessments, policy gates, and still-unobserved reality remain separately labeled.

agency.basis: Tokens, components, states, screenshot evidence, browser executable, viewport contract, runtime probe, render comparisons, observers, artifacts, measurements, assessments, gates, provenance, and repair directions remain inspectable and replaceable.

continuity.basis: The existing Design Genome, render-observation, and plan-digest contracts remain stable anchors while browser runtime, screenshot observers, and before/after comparison add bounded evidence adapters rather than replacing prior meaning.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Invalid or unsupported PNGs fail closed, dimension mismatch holds, digest drift blocks comparison, absent runtime probes hold, ambiguous reduced-motion behavior stays unproven, and missing interaction or perceptual evidence remains HOLD rather than being converted into a synthetic visual-quality claim.
